conditions: A free vendor plan exists (basic profile creation, collect/respond to reviews, basic badges) per the published sponsorship-package breakdown
Third-party guidance says the listing process asks you to place the SoftwareWorld badge on your website and initiate contact by email (andy@softwareworld.co)
Ranking eligibility is tiered: free listings have 'limited visibility and ranking eligibility' — top-50 category ranking needs the Featured plan, top-5 needs Sponsored
requirements: B2B software and services companies — it is a review/ranking marketplace, not a general directory
Listings are 'evaluated by SoftwareWorld's unbiased review team' on user satisfaction, social media buzz, and online presence
The site blocks automated fetching (403 on homepage and subpages), so any submission flow must be done in a real browser
preparation: Company/product profile: name, website, description, logo, category
Willingness to embed the SoftwareWorld badge/widget on your site (per third-party guidance)
Review-collection readiness — the model is built around collecting customer reviews on your profile
Contact email for the listing request
workflow: Attempt to open https://www.softwareworld.co/ in a browser (automated fetches get 403)
Per third-party guidance: place the SoftwareWorld badge on your website, then email andy@softwareworld.co to initiate the listing
Alternatively look for a 'Get Listed' / vendor signup path on the live site (exact current URL unverified)
Wait for the review team's evaluation and profile creation
watchFor: Domain-wide 403 for non-browser clients — do not trust automated checks of submission success; verify in a browser

Badge-display expectation reported by third-party guides — confirm current requirement directly, it may have changed
